$comment: Source of truth for the public RPC edge (docs/PUBLIC-RPC-WAF-GUIDANCE.md). Every method the node can serve (BOING_RPC_SUPPORTED_METHODS in crates/boing-node/src/rpc.rs plus method_catalog in crates/boing-node/schemas/developer_api.json) MUST appear in exactly one class below, or the drift test fails. Regenerate artefacts with: node scripts/public-rpc-edge.mjs generate

rollout.$comment: Start in log mode on both layers, read the Security Events / wrangler tail for a few days, then flip to block / enforce. A plan profile with its own "action" (Free) overrides zone_rule_action.

zone_rules.$comment: Zone rate-limit rules are per client IP (counted per Cloudflare data centre) and cannot see the JSON-RPC method, so they only bound raw POST volume; the per-method-class limits live in the gateway Worker and do not depend on the Cloudflare plan. The rule set depends on the Cloudflare plan: pick it with 'plan' here or '--plan <name>' on apply. Cloudflare limits per plan (https://developers.cloudflare.com/waf/rate-limiting-rules/): Free = 1 rule, period 10 s, mitigation 10 s; Pro = 2 rules; Business = 5; Enterprise = by contract. 'action' on a profile overrides rollout.zone_rule_action. 'match' selects the rate-limit expression the plan supports: path | host_path | host_method.

free.$comment: ONE rule: a generous per-IP guard that only trips on abuse. Free-plan rate-limit expressions may only use Path and Verified Bot (no host, no method; verified live: a host+method expression is accepted by the API but never matches), so this rule matches requests to path / on every proxied hostname of the zone. JSON-RPC is POSTed to / on the public RPC host; 100 hits to / per 10 s from one IP is also far above any human use of the website homepage. A wallet or explorer page makes a handful of POSTs per second; 100 per 10 s (10/s) from one IP is far above that. Blocks for 10 s (the Free minimum and maximum), so a false positive self-heals almost at once. Enforced (block) from the start because log-only gives no protection and the threshold is deliberately loose.

pro.$comment: Pro rate-limit expressions can use Host and Path but not Method, so the rules match host + path / instead of POST.

business.$comment: Business can match on Host and Method.

worker.$comment: Per-IP, per-method-class limits enforced by workers/public-rpc-gateway through the Workers Rate Limiting binding (period must be 10 or 60). Counted per JSON-RPC call, so batches cannot dodge them.

heavy_read.$comment: Allowed but CPU, memory or egress heavy (log scans, blob bytes, VM simulation, signature verification, QA analysis).

submit.$comment: Mempool write. Tighter than reads; the node also enforces its own mempool and per-sender caps.

write.$comment: Other state-changing calls that anyone may legitimately make with a signed payload. Tightest allowed bucket.

faucet.$comment: Testnet faucet. Remove from the allow list (move to blocked) for any mainnet profile. The node adds a 60 s per-account cooldown (-32016).

blocked.$comment: Never served on the public hostname. Operator and admin methods are authenticated on the node (-32057, X-Boing-Operator) but must not even be reachable from the open internet; use the Fly origin or a private path.
